But I thought, this is going to change pretty quickly when we get back to the Capitol Hill because there's some very contentious debates and obviously it's a difficult environment right now. So I went back to my office when we got back to town and I just one page document commitment to stability basically articulating its principles. And in summary, we would do just simple things, show proper respect to one another and everyone else and encourage productive dialogue and model civility and our public and private actions. Pretty simple stuff.
